ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white area across the central lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation is mapped as a thick, irregular border along the leading edges and a dense, jagged cluster at the peduncle insertion point. Scattered mid-intensity grey mottling is present across both medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 2-5 pixels are visible along the lateral trailing edge segments. The edge is significantly smoother towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on the trailing edge of both lobes; the leading edge exhibits a slight concave sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-14 discrete, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the high-intensity central regions, primarily on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of four distinct, parallel, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the distal half of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy linear scarring/rake marks on the right lobe; dense black pigmentation cluster with irregular borders at the fluke-peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique semi-circular dark banding pattern or concentric line cluster is visible on the upper leading edge of the right lobe tip.
